$comment: Large golden fixtures are pulled, never committed (design 3b). `npm run fixtures:pull` fetches every entry below into fixtures/, verifying sha256 and size; `npm test` and `npm run smoke` pull when missing. `url` is relative to `baseUrl`; XWE_FIXTURES_URL overrides `baseUrl`. Until the public registry bucket exists, `baseUrl` is a local file:// mirror (fixtures/README.md, 'Pulled fixtures'); at release it becomes https://models.xorgate.io, where the objects live under the same fixtures/ prefix.
